h1: Custom 1 oz Pouches for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 1 oz pouches for samples, giveaways & more. Perfect for bulk branding at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 1 oz pouches are ideal for distributing small samples, single-serving products, or promotional items at trade shows and events. Their compact size makes them easy to hand out and convenient for recipients to carry. Choose from materials like clear vinyl for visibility or opaque poly for durability. Screen printing or foil stamping adds your logo cleanly. These pouches are a practical choice for safety managers distributing earplugs or HR directors handing out gift cards.
heroAltText: Custom 1 oz pouches with logo imprint, clear vinyl material, and zip closure for promotional use.
